3-COA, 3,5-COA and 3,5,4-COA may be the main hypolipidic components in PTF that can decrease intracellular lipids accumulation through the up-regulation of lipid oxidative genes expression and down-regulation of lipogenic genes expression in HepG2 cells.

three caffeoylquintic acids isolated from Pandanus tectoris fruit, 3-CQ, 3,5-CQ and 3,5,4-CQ, inhibit lipid accumulation in hepG2 cells through regulating the expression of genes related to lipid metabolism.

three caffeoylquinc acid compounds from the fruit of P. tectorius inhibit lipid accumulation in hepatocytes by up-regulating the expressions of PPARα, SREBP1c and CPT-1, and down-regulating those of ACC, FAS and HMGR, which may be the principal mechanisms of their hypolipidemia.
